name: definition-transition-week-pattern-wrong-weekday-and-length
description: Invalid definition (fiscalclock 0.2.0), rejected by the cross-block checks on exceptions.history, which run only when the definition has no block-level error. A week_pattern transition from Monday 2024-07-01 (weeks start on Sunday) to 2024-12-29 is 181 days: it fails both the week-start and the whole-weeks condition, which is one error, and its periods are not compared with a length that is not whole weeks. The complete error list is asserted (code and path of each error, sorted by path, then code).

source.citation: spec/definition-v1.md, exceptions (fiscalclock 0.2.0, ADR-0032), and spec/api-v1.md, Paths for common errors
source.checked_by: Manual reading of the 0.2.0 text of https://github.com/Karthik-beta/fiscalclock/blob/main/spec/definition-v1.md#exceptions and https://github.com/Karthik-beta/fiscalclock/blob/main/spec/api-v1.md#error (Paths for common errors), 2026-11-15; conformance/generators/fiscal_oracle.py Calendar.change_errors gives the same codes, paths and order (asserted)
